owner_decision.context: Chapter VI preparation had recorded the lack of a formal textbook learner procedure for a gas-buoyancy experiment as a follow-up gap.
owner_decision.decision: No separate learner procedure or teacher-observed gas-buoyancy workflow is required for the Chapter VI MVP.
effect: Gas buoyancy remains available for textbook-supported conceptual, comparison, planning and supplied-data questions.
The selected-response pilot will not claim performed-work completion for the gas portion of programme outcome M9.
The earlier procedure follow-up is reclassified as an explicit knowledge-only product-scope boundary and is not a Chapter VI authoring or release blocker.
The five separately governed practical records remain unchanged.

plan_acceptance.basis: The owner's standing instruction to proceed with Chapter VI plus this explicit scope revision.
plan_acceptance.disposition: 15F.1 plan accepted with revision; 15F.2 may create the inactive governed foundation, freeze the related bank and assess Batch 1.

preserved_boundaries: No question can by itself establish that a learner physically performed an experiment.
No U06 database, release, API or runtime state was changed by this documentation decision.
Whole-bank comparison remains mandatory before question staging.
No session length, scoring rule, form allocation or learner release is approved by this decision.
